title: Chapter 2735: Celestial Overlords’ Gathering
content:
Chapter 2735: Celestial Overlords’ Gathering

"I am aware that this won’t magically fix everything," Yuan said calmly. "I didn’t do this for such a reason, either."

"Then why...?" Qiang Qing Yun asked, sounding utterly puzzled.

However, before Yuan could respond, several powerful presences suddenly appeared and enveloped the entire area.

Moments later, numerous figures arrived before them. Among the many powerful presences, three stood out in particular—a handsome green-haired man, an elderly man, and, of course, Xu Jiaqi.

All four Celestial Overlords had suddenly gathered in one place.

’Yuan?! What’s he doing here?!’ Xu Jiaqi cried inwardly after seeing Yuan.

Meanwhile, Liu Yucang and Bi Ao glanced at Yuan for a split second, then turned their attention to Qiang Qing Yun and the Karma Obelisk.

"Xiao? Who the hell is that? And how did they suddenly climb to the top of the ranking?" Liu Yucang questioned aloud.

Since Yuan joined the Celestial Overlords under the alias ’Xiao’, that’s what appeared on the obelisk.

Qiang Qing Yun didn’t respond and looked at Yuan with a perplexed expression, unsure how to answer.

Seeing this, Yuan stepped forward and revealed, "I’m Xiao."

Liu Yucang and Bi Ao shifted their attention back to Yuan, their eyebrows raised in confusion.

"So you’re responsible for our faction’s sudden karma increase? How did you do it? And who are you?" Bi Ao inquired.

"I was recently recruited by Celestial Overlord Qiang," Yuan said. "As for how I increased the karma... sorry, but I won’t be sharing it."

"There’s no way a new recruit who’s only at the third level of God Ascension could’ve gained this much karma so quickly legitimately!" Liu Yucang shouted loudly. "He must’ve messed with the Karma Obelisk in some way!"

Xu Jiaqi then spoke, "The fact that our faction has risen to third place in the Karma Ranking means that the karma he earned was verified by the system itself. That isn’t something that can be achieved simply by manipulating the Karma Obelisk."

"I don’t know how he did it, but there’s no way it’s legit! The amount of karma he’d acquired in such a short time is simply impossible!" Liu Yucang exclaimed, refusing to believe it.

"Legit or not, I don’t care..." Bi Ao said suddenly, taking a step toward Yuan. "I only want to know if you can keep doing it."

Yuan smiled at the old man before replying, "No."

"Are you guys insane?! Do you have any idea what would happen—if it hasn’t already happened—to our reputation once the news spread?! There’s no way the other factions would sit still while we acquired so much questionable karma!" Liu Yucang said.

Although Qiang Qing Yun and Xu Jiaqi didn’t believe Yuan had manipulated the karma system, they agreed with Liu Yucang that acquiring so much karma in the blink of an eye would definitely raise questions.

Moreover, Yuan’s refusal to explain how he acquired the karma would make things even more difficult for them.

Qiang Qing Yun looked at Yuan and asked, "Are you really unwilling to reveal how you acquired the karma? The other factions will be asking questions, and if we can’t provide an answer... things might get ugly, you know?"

Yuan quietly nodded.

If he revealed that he had earned the karma by killing demons, they would inevitably realize that he and the Divine Paragon were one and the same and, more importantly, that the Divine Paragon was still alive.

"Alright," Qiang Qing Yun said without the slightest change in her expression.

Her calm response left not only Bi Ao and Liu Yucang speechless, but even Xu Jiaqi was dumbfounded by how casually she was behaving.

While Qiang Qing Yun was by no means a strict individual like Xu Jiaqi, she wasn’t a pushover either. As a Celestial Overlord, it made little sense for her to let Yuan keep such an important secret, especially when the faction would face trouble because of it.

Xu Jiaqi looked between Qiang Qing Yun and Yuan, her eyes darting back and forth as she tried to figure out what kind of relationship they had.

"Y-You can’t be serious!" Liu Yucang exclaimed in disbelief, trembling with anger.

"Fine! If you won’t do your job, I’ll do it for you!"

Liu Yucang started walking toward Yuan, his ninth-level God Ascension cultivation surging violently around him.

"You dare lay a hand on my recruit in front of me?" Qiang Qing Yun narrowed her eyes as her own aura erupted with equal intensity.

Their auras collided, causing the entire world to tremble.

"This isn’t just about you or your recruit! This is a matter that could cause irreversible damage to the faction! Even before the incident with Heaven’s Mandate, the other factions were already waiting for our downfall!" Liu Yucang shouted angrily. "Now that we’ve suffered two major incidents back-to-back, there’s no doubt they’ll try to destroy us while they still have the chance!"

Qiang Qing Yun sneered disdainfully. "If I didn’t know any better, I might actually believe you cared about the faction’s well-being after hearing such heartfelt words."

"You damn alcoholic bitch! What the hell do you know about me and my passion?!" Liu Yucang roared, veins bulging all over his face.

"What did you just call me, you ugly broccoli head?!" Qiang Qing Yun gritted her teeth in anger.

"B-Broccoli head?! I’ll fucking kill you!"

Seeing how things were quickly getting out of hand, Xu Jiaqi stepped between them and said coldly, "Are you two trying to destroy the headquarters?"

Qiang Qing Yun and Liu Yucang’s aura began to calm down after hearing Xu Jiaqi’s words.

Although it was common for the Celestial Overlords to bicker among themselves, their disputes had never escalated to the point of actual violence. Had Xu Jiaqi not stepped in, however, that would have undoubtedly changed.

As the atmosphere calmed down, Yuan suddenly remembered something and muttered, "Hm? Liu Yucang?"

Liu Yucang’s gaze snapped toward Yuan, his eyes filled with killing intent.

"Who gave you permission to utter my name?"

A smile tugged at Yuan’s lips as he responded, "Then should I call you bush head instead?"

"W-What?" Liu Yucang’s eyes widened in disbelief at the nickname, his mouth falling open in shock.
